title: DataFrame 惰性求值：构建期零执行，action 才触发
expected_output:
== 构建 DataFrame 操作链（只登记逻辑计划，不执行） ==
  [登记] Filter(salary > 60)   此时 EXEC_COUNT=0
  [登记] Project(dept,salary)   此时 EXEC_COUNT=0
  [登记] Aggregate(groupBy=dept)   此时 EXEC_COUNT=0
逻辑计划: Scan(employee) -> Filter(salary > 60) -> Project(dept,salary) -> Aggregate(groupBy=dept)
构建阶段 EXEC_COUNT = 0
== 触发 action: collect() ==
collect 返回行数 = 8
action 之后 EXEC_COUNT = 1
== 再触发 action: count() ==
count 返回 = 12
action 之后 EXEC_COUNT = 2
惰性求值判据（构建期=0 且 两次 action 后=2）: True
